display.title: Tetra: Forge a Modular Blade
display.subtitle: Hammer out your first weapon
description: At the Tetra Workbench, slot a hilt and a blade to forge a §emodular sword§r —
your first piece of truly modular gear. Then take the §6Forge Hammer§r to it:
§ehoning§r repairs and improves a module's integrity as you use it.
§7Forging and honing are the long game of deep specialization — every tier
§7adds better materials to slot into this same frame.
